operator_ruling.interpretation: The discovery lane searches ZoomInfo only. Apollo and Lusha are removed from the DISCOVERY lane (not from stage-2 enrichment, which keeps the full ZoomInfo -> Apollo -> Lusha waterfall untouched). No reveal-in-lane, so no `kind: design` todo is required -- this is a narrowing of the search-only lane's provider set, not a scope change to what the lane does.
operator_ruling.basis: Rounds 2-4 measured all three providers live (this document, and 73.1-D12-VERDICT.round2/3/4.json): ZoomInfo's preview carries real firstName/lastName/jobTitle values at 0 measured credits (balance 9352 -> 9352 across all three rounds); Apollo's preview carries only last_name_obfuscated -- never a real last name -- and its balance is unreadable on this account (403); Lusha's preview carries no name or title at all (contactId/companyId/companyName/fqdn/has*-flags/isShown only) and costs 1 credit per REQUEST even on a zero-result round (cross-run balance 3615 -> 3614 -> 3613 across rounds 2-4, charged after the response returns so each round's own in-round delta reads 0).
